reference_A.sql: SELECT t.team_id,COUNT(DISTINCT s.employee_id) AS june_workers FROM teams t LEFT JOIN employees e ON e.team_id=t.team_id LEFT JOIN shifts s ON s.employee_id=e.employee_id AND s.starts_at>=TIMESTAMPTZ '2026-06-01' AND s.starts_at<TIMESTAMPTZ '2026-07-01' GROUP BY t.team_id ORDER BY t.team_id

reference_B.sql: SELECT t.team_id,(SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT s.employee_id) FROM employees e JOIN shifts s ON s.employee_id=e.employee_id WHERE e.team_id=t.team_id AND s.starts_at>=TIMESTAMPTZ '2026-06-01' AND s.starts_at<TIMESTAMPTZ '2026-07-01') AS june_workers FROM teams t ORDER BY t.team_id

cases.question: For each employee, return employee ID and the latest completed training date.

reference_A.sql: SELECT e.employee_id,MAX(t.completed_on) AS latest_training_on FROM employees e LEFT JOIN training_records t ON t.employee_id=e.employee_id GROUP BY e.employee_id ORDER BY e.employee_id
